# HackerRank – Developer Hiring & Skills Platform with Online Coding Tests and Technical Interviews

HackerRank is the leading platform for hiring software engineering talent and developer upskilling. Features include automated screening tests, real-time pair programming interviews with an AI-assisted IDE, certified skill assessments, AI plagiarism detection, and deep ATS integrations.

HackeRank is also home to the largest and most active developer community  dedicated to learning programming skills and technical interview preparation.

Companies use HackerRank to assess, interview, and hire engineering talent with real coding challenges and expertly curated technical interview questions.

Developers use HackerRank to learn, compete in coding contests, earn certifications, and land jobs by showcasing verified skills.

## HackerRank Home Page

- [HackerRank](https://www.hackerrank.com/): Explore HackerRank’s full suite of developer hiring, skill evaluation, and talent branding solutions or join the leading free Developer Community to practice your coding skills and earn verified certifications.

## HackerRank for Companies Hiring Developers with Technical Code Interviews

- [HackerRank for Candidate Screening](https://www.hackerrank.com/products/screen): Automate and standardize technical assessments to identify qualified candidates efficiently.
- [HackerRank for Technical Interviews](https://www.hackerrank.com/products/interview): Conduct real-time coding interviews with collaborative tools designed for technical hiring.
- [HackerRank Engage for attracting and retaining talent](https://www.hackerrank.com/products/engage): Showcase your tech brand and engage developers through competitions and challenges.
- [HackerRank SkillUp](https://www.hackerrank.com/products/skillup): Upskill and redeploy internal talent by assessing and developing employee technical skills.
- [Certified Assessments](https://www.hackerrank.com/features/certified-assessments): Use standardized assessments to evaluate candidates with verified skill credentials.
- [Plagiarism Detection](https://www.hackerrank.com/features/plagiarism-detection): Prevent cheating in technical interviewing tests with industry-leading plagiarism detection.
- [Real World Coding Questions](https://www.hackerrank.com/features/real-world-questions): Access a library of role-relevant coding questions modeled after real-world challenges to accelerate candidate screening and technical interviewing.
- [HackerRank Integrations](https://www.hackerrank.com/features/integrations): Connect HackerRank with your ATS, HRIS, and other hiring platforms seamlessly.

## HackerRank Products and Features for Developers looking to train for Technical Interviews
- [Interview Preparation Kits - HackerRank](https://www.hackerrank.com/interview): Kits designed to help candidates prepare for coding interviews with curated challenges and learning paths.
- [HackerRank Certifications](https://www.hackerrank.com/skills-directory): Validate your technical skills with role-based certifications recognized by employers.

## HackerRank Solutions for Enterprise Companies
- [Skills Strategy with HackerRank](https://www.hackerrank.com/solutions/skills-strategy): Build a strategic framework for assessing and growing technical talent.
- [Talent Brand Solutions](https://www.hackerrank.com/solutions/talent-brand): Elevate your employer brand by engaging developers with personalized content and challenges.
- [Optimize Your Hiring](https://www.hackerrank.com/solutions/optimize-hiring): Streamline your hiring funnel with data-driven insights and automation tools.
- [Internal Mobility Solutions](https://www.hackerrank.com/solutions/internal-mobility): Identify and mobilize internal talent through assessments and upskilling.
- [Remote Hiring Solutions](https://www.hackerrank.com/solutions/remote-hiring): Hire technical talent remotely with tools optimized for distributed interviews and assessments.
- [University Hiring Solutions](https://www.hackerrank.com/solutions/university-hiring): Attract and assess students from top universities with scalable campus hiring solutions.
- [Data Annotation Services](https://www.hackerrank.com/ai/services): Access high-quality data labeling services for training and validating AI models.

## Additional Resources from HackerRank
- [HackerRank Blog](https://www.hackerrank.com/blog/): Read insights, hiring trends, and developer stories from the HackerRank community.
- [2025 Developer Skills Report](https://www.hackerrank.com/reports/developer-skills-report-2025): HackerRank’s annual data‑driven analysis of developer hiring trends, skills in demand, AI adoption, and upskilling priorities in 2025.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hackerrank.com/about-us/privacy): HackerRank's privacy policy outlining data handling practices.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.hackerrank.com/about-us/terms-of-service): The terms governing the use of HackerRank services.
- [Trust](https://www.hackerrank.com/trust/): Information on trust and security measures in place.
- [Product support](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us): Support resources for product-related inquiries.
- [HackerRank Scoring](https://www.hackerrank.com/scoring): Details on the scoring system used in assessments and contests.
- [HackerRank Writing](https://www.hackerrank.com/writing): An editorial content hub from HackerRank featuring articles, guides, and insights.

    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const target = e.target;
      if (target!==null && ['A', 'BUTTON', 'INPUT', 'SELECT', 'I'].includes(target.tagName)) {
        if (target.getAttribute("data-analytics")) {
          action = "Click"; data = target.getAttribute("data-analytics");

            return;

            hr_metrics.batch_track(action, data, (function() {
                var params={};
                for (var _i=1; _i<=12; ++_i){
                    var _attr = 'data-attr'+_i;
                    if (target.getAttribute(_attr)){
                        params['attribute'+_i] = target.getAttribute(_attr);
                }}
                var attributes = target.attributes, attr_length = target.attributes.length;
                for (var i = 0; i < attr_length; i++){
                  var attribute = attributes[i];
                  if (attribute.name.indexOf('data-attr-') === 0){
                    param_name = attribute.name.substr('data-attr-'.length);
                    if (param_name.length > 0) {
                      params[param_name] = attribute.value;
                    }
                  }
                }
                return params;
            })());
        // google analytics

    });
